# A10′ — The Uncounted Enters the Account

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A10 — Advent of Zero](../A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

**Standing:** conjugate argument-proposal; the prime face of [A10 — Advent of Zero](../A10-Advent-of-Zero.md). The advent discipline is the partner's argued operation re-sited at the demographic-cognitive register. The crossover instance is **Paraphrased** venue material under the brief's standing scenario modality. C-ground: S4/P5 — observed state, material evidence.

## #0

A ratio flips. At the cognitive crossover machines perform most cognitive labour, and humans "act as a slower abstraction layer guiding a much larger field of artificial cognition" ([q012](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q012)). [A10](../A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) reads the event with the discipline it earned at zero's arithmetic citizenship: "nothing" becomes a discriminable operative place — a positional blank whose neighbouring marks acquire their value from position, an [[section-rooms/arguments/A10-Advent-of-Zero.md#0|Operative Absence]] doing work before anyone has said what it means. At the crossover the human contribution is exactly that place. The synthetic outputs are the counted presences; the guiding work is present as structure, not as volume. The uncounted has entered the account — zero's advent recurring in demographic form, a gain in determination held before its symbolic questions settle. The blank must not be misread: it is not a value-zero, and the account that carries it is not permitted to convert position into a judgment of worth. The uncounted participant is the account's live condition.

## #1

Positional zero became an arithmetic citizen through explicit rules — addition by zero leaves a quantity unchanged, multiplication by zero yields zero — and the crossover's blank acquires rules of the same explicitness. Humans "remain normatively central but computationally secondary," the shift running "toward value-setting, oversight, and long-horizon judgment" ([q013](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q013)): the blank is handled, routed, budgeted. The brief also supplies the discipline's undercount theorem. Single-agent horizon benchmarks are "a systematic undercount" because "long horizons are a property of groups," coherence passing "from sub-agent to artifact to sub-agent without meaningful loss" ([q031](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q031)). An account that must learn to count a composition discovers the human position structurally indispensable and numerically blank at once — the Count/Account operation A10 consumes from the [Encounter / Region / Name / Count whole field](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md), here in its technological register: "who performed this work?" becomes a markable absence that participates in the social account.

## #2

The edge of zero's citizenship was division — the one place the containing rules had to declare themselves. The crossover's edge is the same office. Where the account must say what it is counting, it cannot settle: volume of synthetic text is not intelligence; cognitive labour is not the worth of a participant; a ratio under a criterion is not a census of minds. The brief holds this itself — [q013](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q013) brackets its composite-organism claim with "Or, something else?", and §1.2 asks whether the present mania "is what a cognitive crossover point feels like." This is not an omitted measurement that could later be supplied. It is the [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C04-Formal-Limit|Formal Limit]] between an exact count and the condition of counting, and the account stays strongest where it declines to settle what its counted presences are.

## #3

The brief's own precedent gives the advent its first crossover. §1.2 recalls the physical-labour crossover around 1900 — "In what ways did they know this in 1900? Could they feel it in their bodies as their muscles were no longer so preeminent? We see it in the literature, the fears, the utopias of the time" — a sign held before its meaning settles, legible first as ambiance and image. Taylor's [Advent-Zero manuscript](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-advent-zero-subject/taylor-2026-advent-zero-subject.md) sources the structure: a term "enters the field of number, changes what the field can do, becomes ordinary enough to disappear into the background of rationality, and returns." The demographic tilt of §1.1 (uncarded; verified against the local transcription, PDF p. 10) and the staged ratios — eight billion human minds against "800 billion or a trillion" non-human (PDF p. 4) — make *what is a "society"?* the symbolic question the tilt opens without settling.

## #4

Zero travelled through algorithms, teaching, tables and trade whose users needed no agreement about emptiness. The crossover travels through dashboards, capability accounting and organisational design: institutions reorganise around an exact ratio whose question — what is the intelligence being counted, and whose? — recedes into routine. That recession is the danger. The convenience of the immediate account cannot erase the labour displaced beyond its view; extraction is the pathology of an advent that never returns. [A15′](A15-prime-The-Measure-Constitutes.md) carries the measure-discipline this demands; [A29′](A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md) the return-route itself.

## #5→0

The crossover is the second advent's technological form: an operative absence, exact before it is meaningful, whose return-route must remain open. The uncounted position re-enters the account through attribution, evidence and revision — who actually did what — retained against the account's drift toward taking its own ratio for the world. [A36′](A36-prime-Integral-Zero-of-the-Hybrid-Society.md) receives the completed return: the exact signs of the crossover becoming symbol again without ceasing to be exact.

The page **returns-to** [A10 — Advent of Zero](../A10-Advent-of-Zero.md): the advent discipline holds at the technological register — determination first, meaning unsettled, return owed — and to the root [A/C](AC.md), the full `0/1` field of which this blank is a determination.

**Depth Restoration:** advent discipline (determination before settlement), the Count/Account operation at technological register, the double-advent structure from Taylor's manuscript, the brief's 1900 precedent, and the undercount theorem (q031) are restored. Pass 2 recomposes the prose from the argument outward; every brief attribution keeps its pass-1 verification against the source house and the local transcription.

**Unresolved Delta:** §1.1's demographic tilt and the 1900 reception history are the brief's scenario material and remain uncarded in the source house. The crossover's empirical shape ("obviously not evenly distributed") is asserted by the venue, not measured here; no labour-market or welfare outcome is established. The second-advent completion depends on A36′ and the root's promotion.
